raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-18 the source sends amount corrections as a repeated txn_id with a higher record_version, so silver_transactions holds both the original and the corrected row. Fix: keep only the latest version per txn_id, and apply the POSTED filter after that choice so a latest version that is not POSTED correctly drops the transaction.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
